items.title: A check, not a show
items.body:
This is the week boss. You already met these faults. You are only proving you can name them.

1. **No map in the pack** :  you sent pages and no booklet.
2. **Leftover Track Changes** :  the review was not finished.
3. **Two homes** :  a desktop copy and a zip both claimed to be the real files.

Fail the quiz and **week 8 stays locked**. Retry as many times as you want. The 5-minute warmup does not open the week.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Handoff** :  giving someone else a pack they can open. Map, pages, cover note, one home.

items.title: Tone
items.body: Messy packs are normal the first time. Repair them. Then go home.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Three handoff faults.

This lab can fail. Fail when: The check copy still has no map, or leftover insertions are still in the page, or the note still claims two homes.

Expected: Map present. Review clean enough to send. One-home sentence. Send list written.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Three handoff faults.
blocks.intro: How to Three handoff faults. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Three handoff faults
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Copy kitepump to oxygen-bootcamp-work/week7-check/ so you do not wreck the original.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Fault 1: make a pack with topics and no map, then add the map back. Run completeness.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Fault 2: turn on Track Changes, leave two leftover insertions, then accept or reject with intent. File opens clean.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Fault 3: a note that says ‘the files live on my desktop and in the zip and both are home’. Rewrite it to one home.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: List the files you would send a reviewer, in 60 seconds, in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week7-check/send-list.txt.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Pass the quiz. You can retry it. Week 8 stays locked until this day is finished (lab + quiz + a short note).

blocks.q: You failed this check. Does week 8 open anyway?
options: Yes, the Friday page is enough
No. Finish this day’s lab, quiz, and note. You can retry the quiz.
Yes, if you do the 5-minute warmup
blocks.why: Next week waits until you can hand off a book with one home and a finished review. Retry is free.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: A reviewer pack is missing the map. What breaks?
options: Nothing :  each page is a full book
Pointers, keys, and neighbor pages. The reviewer cannot see the booklet
blocks.why: The pack is a book. The map is the table of contents. No map, no book.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: Web Author is the same thing as the desktop app, just in a browser. What is still true?
options: Every desktop button is in the browser tab
Same company and same kind of page. Fewer tools. Completeness and local publish still live on the desktop
The browser tab stores the only copy of the files
blocks.why: Thinner desk. Same writing app. You still pick one place the files live.
